title: Dukkhatāsuttaṃ
text: 165 . ‘‘Tisso imā, bhikkhave, dukkhatā. Katamā tisso? Dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso dukkhatā. Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ dukkhatānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya…pe… aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo’’ti. Pañcamaṃ.
